title: Wang Gang (美食作家王刚) — cooking actions per recipe (heat, vessels, manipulation, endpoints)
method: Read-only on inputs. For each of the 42 recipes in wanggang_recipes.json the referenced YouTube subtitle file was parsed (zh/zh-Hans/zh-CN = his own narration where it exists, 23 videos; otherwise the channel's official en translation, 19 videos). Phases were extracted by hand from the full transcript; every quote fragment was then machine-checked to appear verbatim in the cited cue range (280 quotes, 0 mismatches). No amounts or times invented: unknown = null with his wording kept. Durations: 'stated' = he gives the time; 'est' = estimated from his wording with the rules in est_rules; 'video_1take' = read from timestamps of an uncut one-take (一镜版) video. Temperatures: 'stated' or 'conv:N成x30' (his 6成 ≈ 180 °C, 30 °C per 成). Masses: 1斤 = 500 g, 1两 = 50 g, liquids ≈ 1 g/ml. Phases flagged alt_variant (西兰花 白灼/蚝油, 炝炒油麦菜, 鲈鱼 进阶 sauce) count for presence statistics but not for per-dish timing or heat changes. Marinating, egg beating and cutting are out of scope (prep, covered by the seasoning pass).

est_rules.few_stirs: 翻炒几下 / 翻几下 / a few (couple of) stirs / give a little stir ≈ 3 s
est_rules.mix: 炒匀 / 拌匀 / until well mixed ≈ 10 s
est_rules.fragrant: 炒香 / 炒出香味 / 炒出红油 / until fragrant or coloured ≈ 20 s (range 10–30)
est_rules.thicken: starch sauce (碗汁/水淀粉) poured into the hot wok until it thickens ≈ 10 s
est_rules.just_cooked: 断生 / 变色 / until just cooked (shredded or thin items) ≈ 30 s (range 20–60)
est_rules.video_1take: uncut one-take video timestamps (干煸四季豆, 手撕包菜)

spot_check.method: random.sample of the 42 recipe ids; each rendered phase table re-read line by line against the cooking section of its transcript (order, vessel, heat words, times, cues, transfers, quotes)

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold the wok away from the fire while putting chicken in and stirring it in the oil
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: Move the wok away from the fire once the oil is in / Put the chicken in and fry it to 80% done

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold the pan off the burner while pouring starch slurry and pushing the tofu with a ladle (x2)
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: At the third minute, take the pan off the burner. / For the second time, add a small amount of starchy water to thicken it.

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: a helper pours the broth into the wok while he cooks
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 四伯爷 帮我倒一下 / 啊 不要倒完了

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: pour the whole wok of hot oil + food out and filter it (wok in one hand, strainer/oil container in the other)
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: Pout them all out of the pot and filter the oil.

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold the wok off the fire while adding oil and meat and moving it (滑熟 off heat)
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 锅烧热烧透之后离火 / 加入植物油1勺 / 然后把腌制好的里脊肉下锅滑熟

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: drain fried eggplant and pour the hot oil out of the wok
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: after that, take out and drain the eggplants / and pour out the hot oil

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold a wok of 240 °C oil away from the stove while adding and frying the chicken for 20 s, then strain it
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: Take the wok away from the stove / Fry the chicken for a second time for 20 seconds

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: lift chicken out with a strainer while holding the wok / clean debris
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: Now filter out the chicken with a strainer / and clean up the debris

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold the wok off the fire while adding fish slices one by one
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 然后将锅离火 / 锅离火之后再把腌制好的鱼片依次下锅

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: pour the soup from the wok into the 盆 while holding back the dregs
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 大火烧开之后再把鱼汤倒入盆中 / 请大家注意最后有一些渣必须将其分离开

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: lift and separate fried pieces with a 漏勺 while holding the wok
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 两分钟之后再用漏勺捞出分散 / 里脊分散之后将其捞出

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: pour excess oil out of the wok while holding the meat back
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 肉丝炒熟炒散之后再倒出锅中多余的油

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: lift a whole chicken out of hot water and tip its cavity water out, then dunk it in a second basin
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 然后提起来把它肚子里面的水倒出来

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: helper heats the oil for 泼油 while he cuts
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 好 等我切好你烧点油给它浇一下

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: flip a whole 900 g fish in the wok without breaking it
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 然后中途将其翻面过来继续煎香

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: lift the braised whole fish out onto a plate intact
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 6分钟之后将鲤鱼捞出摆盘

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold the garnish shreds aside with chopsticks while tipping the plate juices out
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 首先把姜葱丝和辣椒丝用筷子夹起 / 再倒出盘中的汤汁和“鱼酱油”

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: pour the boiled sauce through a strainer onto the fish
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 最后过滤出残渣之后再重新淋在鱼身上面即可

10_two_hands_or_helper.dish: 清炒菠菜 / 炝炒油麦菜
10_two_hands_or_helper.what: hold the wok spoon with salt/sugar while pouring boiled water into it, then tip it into the wok
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: add some seasonings such as salt and white sugar into the wok spoon / Then add some boiled water into the spoon

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: pour tofu + brain slowly from the soak bowl into the wok without breaking them
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 脑花和豆腐一起倒出来 / 一定要慢一点 / 这个一下子倒出来的话会把它冲烂

10_two_hands_or_helper.what: shake the starch bowl, pour a little, then push in the wok, 4 rounds
10_two_hands_or_helper.quote: 轻轻给它晃一下 / 然后倒一点下来 / 加下去了再推
